needed.suggestion: Create a proper sidewalk on the left side to improve pedestrian safety.
Remove obstructions from the left sidewalk to ensure it remains clear and usable.
Repair uneven sections on the right sidewalk to reduce trip hazards.
Install a marked pedestrian crossing to increase visibility and safety.
Improve the facilities at crossings to ensure they are adequate for pedestrian use.
Add a refuge island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.
Install dropped kerbs to signal pedestrian crossings.
Install additional street lights to improve visibility along the road.
